from datetime import datetime

# Define the end time of the meeting and the start time of lunch
meeting_end_time = datetime.strptime('2024-05-15 11:00:00', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
lunch_start_time = datetime.strptime('2024-05-15 12:30:00', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')

# Calculate the time difference
time_difference = lunch_start_time - meeting_end_time

# Convert the time difference to hours and minutes
hours = time_difference.seconds // 3600
minutes = (time_difference.seconds // 60) % 60

# Format the result as 'HH:MM'
result = f'{hours:02d}:{minutes:02d}'

print(result)
